findings.description: The instance user_data script embeds a long-lived AWS access key ID (AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMAAA) and secret access key in cleartext. User data is retrievable from the EC2 instance metadata service by any process on the host (or via SSRF), and is stored in the instance configuration and visible in the console/API, handing out static account credentials.

SSH (tcp/22) ingress is open to 0.0.0.0/0, exposing the portal server's administrative interface to the entire internet and enabling brute-force and exploitation attempts. This is aggravated by public IP auto-assignment on portal_subnet_a.

HTTP (tcp/80) ingress is open to 0.0.0.0/0 with no compensating controls. Combined with map_public_ip_on_launch on portal_subnet_a, the web service is directly reachable from any source on the internet.
Egress permits all protocols and all ports to 0.0.0.0/0, so a compromised instance can freely exfiltrate data and reach arbitrary external hosts for command-and-control.

map_public_ip_on_launch = true on a subnet associated with a route table holding a 0.0.0.0/0 internet gateway route means instances launched here (including portal_server) receive public IPs directly reachable from the internet.
map_public_ip_on_launch = true combined with a default route to the internet gateway exposes every instance launched in this subnet to the public internet, removing a layer of network isolation.
The EBS volume attached to portal_server has no encrypted = true setting and no KMS key, so data written to the disk is stored in plaintext at rest and in snapshots.
The snapshot of the unencrypted portal_server_disk is created without encryption, so volume contents are preserved in plaintext and could be shared or restored insecurely.
The bucket storing VPC flow logs has no server-side encryption configuration, so captured flow log objects are stored unencrypted by default.

No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is defined for the bucket, so public ACLs and public bucket policies are not blocked; the flow log archive has no protective boundary if a permissive policy or ACL is ever applied.
force_destroy = true allows the bucket and all retained flow log objects to be deleted non-emptily, destroying security audit evidence and undermining log integrity.
